serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #Annalie.face.normal You: I just figured that there isn’t really any future for me in this city. Lady Annalie: Hmmm… Lady Annalie: It’s not like I don’t know where you are coming from, but it’s not like this place is so much different than the rest. Lady Annalie: The world economy is in shambles, and most of the laws are being passed as international agreements to bypass the democratic process, so there aren't really many places that are any different from this megacity. Lady Annalie: And the places that are different cost so much money that even getting there requires a small fortune, not even mentioning being able to afford to live there for the rest of your life. Lady Annalie: Fake it till you make it, as they say. Unfortunately, not many of us are going to make it… Lady Annalie: And these places aren’t that great anyway, As long as you don’t bother others you can do pretty much whatever you want! No one cares! #Annalie.Eyes.normal+Annalie.Mouth.pervy Lady Annalie: For example… The Paradisium Island is full of sex perverts~ #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.normal You: So you would fit right in. Lady Annalie: Oh, I know that for such a tame guy like you, I’m probably the most pervy girl you have ever known, but I promise you. The shit that goes on there is next level. Lady Annalie: We are talking about ****** ****** and ******** with ********* and that’s just the tip of the iceberg. You: Jesus… #Annalie.face.normal Lady Annalie: So unless you want to see a bunch of creepy old dudes doing this and that on a public beach, I wouldn’t recommend it! You: Y-Yeah, that place seems kind of too hardcore for me… But on the other hand, I wouldn’t need to worry about {f_botName} true identity being exposed… You: Is there any other place, similar to Paradisium, that does not involve doing this and that? I feel like all that money I have will be wasted… #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: {{punch}}Wait, you actually have enough money to go there?! How much?! You: W-Well, I don’t think sharing my bank account with anyone is a good idea… #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.pervy Lady Annalie: Oh, come on! You already said this much, what difference does it make now? You: I guess… #Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: Don’t worry, your secret is totally~ safe with me. Hehehe~ You: You aren’t exactly filling me with trust right now… Lady Annalie: Come on! Don’t be a wuss! You: Alright. #Annalie.face.shocked You: I have {gv_money}$. Lady Annalie: {{punch}}What?! {{Wi}}{{punch}}How did you manage that?! You: Stop screaming! People will notice… #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.normal Lady Annalie: It’s not fair! It’s not fair! It’s not fair! I want to be rich too! You: Yeah, but I don’t really feel like this Paradisium Island is a good fit for me… Although having a sexbot might be considered freaky by most of society, I would rather not include myself in that category… Lady Annalie: You piece of garbage! I struggle everyday here, and you just became rich out of nowhere?! Not fair! Lady Annalie: That’s it! I’m gonna charge you twice as much from now on! You: W-Why?! Lady Annalie: Tax the rich, bitch! You: That’s not fair, I haven't even been rich for that long! Lady Annalie: So what? Tell me! How did you manage that?! I want quick and easy money too! Was it the lottery?! You: Yeah, something like that… #Annalie.face.sad Lady Annalie: Lucky bastard… You: Can we get back on track, though? Lady Annalie: Sure, why not. All of a sudden, I don’t feel like working at all. I might close down this shop. It’s all pointless anyway. You: Come on, now… Lady Annalie: Places aside from Paradisium? There are a few ethnic states, but I doubt they would allow you to join. They have strict entry criteria. #Annalie.face.shocked Lady Annalie: Actually… considering how pale you are you could probably make it. #Annalie.face.sad Lady Annalie: But I don’t think you’d want to live like a XVIII-century German peasant. Lady Annalie: Most of the places that advertise themselves as a heaven on earth are just scams. No one’s gonna build a futuristic utopia in the middle of nowhere. Lady Annalie: If you for real have that much money as you say, Paradisium is the safest bet. It’s maybe not the most moral choice, but your money won’t go down the drain. You: Paradisium seems like the only realistic choice, then. #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: Oh, right. I forgot about a pretty important detail, hehe~ Her creepy smile means trouble… Lady Annalie: There’s a vouching system in place. You won’t get there without having one of the citizens vouching for you. Lady Annalie: Oh, you poor guy~ Even with all that money, you are stuck here~ How sad! You: … #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.normal You: So, what am I supposed to do? Do I need to find someone or… Lady Annalie: How the fuck should I know? You: Come on, now… Lady Annalie: I think it’s time for you to go, sir. You: Wha- Are you kicking me out? Lady Annalie: Yes! Exactly! Time is money, and I have no time to lose! I want to be rich too! Your shop is still empty though… #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.smile She’s been acting scary for a while now, so going back home doesn’t seem like a bad idea. You: Well then, see you later.
